biotools.summary: CDLIB is a Python library for clustering and network embedding that enhances biological interpretability and predictive power by improving how protein-protein interaction networks are represented. It integrates Hierarchical Link Clustering (HLC) and allows for the identification of novel gene candidates associated with RASopathies.
